title: 第十六章 便宜的解法
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
紧接着，秦天就看到在自己的道具栏里出现了相应的建造图纸。

    不得不说，这个完成交易的速度，还算是快的，几乎就没怎么浪费时间，就已经完成了交易。东西来到他手里，这个过程可以说是很快了。

    最后的这个结果对他而言也还能够接受，总的说来，其实很简单，无非就是相当于自己直接用2000领主币的代价，从对方的手上直接获得了这张制造图纸。

    而这张图纸对现在的他而言，也是很有帮助的，虽然损失了元素石，但只要把这个东西给建造出来，接下来，领地的发展速度会变得更快。

    所以，从这个角度上来讲，自己并没有吃亏。

    只是略有一些遗憾，原本还以为对方好骗，想试试看能不能骗到人，现在看来，计谋倒是没那么容易成功。

    与此同时，另外那边，叶洛璃也得到了交易成功的提醒。

    松一口气的同时，美眸里面也是几分异样的神色。

    她都有点不知道该说什么好了。

    如果这个叫秦天的完全是一个正常人，那双方之间这样交易过后，她根本不会有任何留意的地方。

    也不会因此而有什么情绪上的波动，哪怕只是一点点。

    可是偏偏，这个家伙就是一副奇怪的样子，刚才两人在谈价格的时候，都差点儿没谈妥。

    还想从自己这儿捞到更多的好处？

    不是，这家伙觉醒出强大的天赋，难道还能这么淡定这么不要脸的吗？

    作为首个升级领地的领主，不知道有多少玩家，早已将他当做大佬一样看待。

    结果这就是大佬的作风？

    一点包袱都没有的吗？就这样问别人要好处，想从别人那儿捞点儿东西？

    反而是这样的人，更会让她觉得好奇。

    嗯...主要是有点好奇，这家伙以前是干什么的，为什么会有这么抽象的行为！

    类人行为！

    不过，看到在自己储物栏当中出现的那颗元素石，叶洛璃的表情也变得渐渐缓和。

    这还差不多...

    好歹自己也是得到了想要的东西，有了这颗石头以后，自己很快就能进行特殊建筑的建造，可以大幅度提升自己的发育速度。

    这样才能尽可能抢占先机，先一步领先其他的玩家！

    而后叶洛璃就开始了自己的计划。

    看着建造出来的新型建筑，脸上也是止不住的喜悦。
content_en:
Immediately afterwards, Qin Tian saw the corresponding construction drawings appearing in his prop inventory.

    I have to say that the speed at which the transaction was completed was quite fast. The transaction was completed with almost no time wasted. When the things came into his hands, the process could be said to be very fast.

    The final result was acceptable to him. Generally speaking, it was actually very simple. It was nothing more than the cost of 2,000 Lord Coins to directly obtain this manufacturing blueprint from the other party.

    And this drawing is also very helpful to him now. Although he has lost the elemental stone, as long as this thing is built, the territory will develop faster in the future.

    Therefore, from this perspective, I did not suffer a loss.

    I just feel a little regretful. I originally thought that the other party was easy to deceive and wanted to try to see if I could deceive people. But now it seems that the plan is not so easy to succeed.

    At the same time, on the other side, Ye Luoli also received a reminder that the transaction was successful.

    While he breathed a sigh of relief, there was also a strange look in his beautiful eyes.

    She didn't know what to say.

    If this person named Qin Tian was a completely normal person, she would not have paid any attention to it after such a transaction between the two parties.

    There won't be any emotional fluctuations because of this, even just a little bit.

    However, this guy looked strange. When the two of them were discussing the price just now, they almost failed to reach an agreement.

    Still want to get more benefits from yourself?

    No, this guy has awakened a powerful talent, how can he be so calm and shameless?

    As the first lord to upgrade his territory, countless players have already treated him like a boss.

    Turns out this is the boss’s style?

    No baggage at all? Are you just asking for benefits from others, trying to get something from others?

    On the contrary, people like this make her even more curious.

    Well... Mainly I'm a little curious, what did this guy do before, and why did he behave in such an abstract way!

    Humanoid behavior!

    However, Ye Luoli's expression gradually softened when she saw the elemental stone appearing in her storage column.

    That's pretty much it...

    At least, I got what I wanted. With this stone, I can quickly build special buildings, which can greatly increase my development speed.

    In this way, we can seize the opportunity as much as possible and be one step ahead of other players!

    Then Ye Luoli started his own plan.

    Looking at the new buildings being built, I can’t help but feel joy on my face.
